result.title: Semantic Synthesis over Brute-Force Search: LLM-Guided Transformation Design for Efficient Learning
result.summary: Data transformation pipelines shape the training distribution in computer vision, but designing them is a computationally expensive problem. We investigate whether large language models can enable efficient discovery by synthesizing executable transformation programs outside predefined augmentation spaces. We compare nine strategies under a unified training protocol, including standard augmentation policies, brute-force search, direct code generation with two LLMs, and performance-guided generation using LLMs fine-tuned on accuracy-ordered transformation pairs. When the best candidates are retrained for 20 epochs, LLM-generated transformation programs lead on every dataset, reaching 0.8877 accuracy on CIFAR-10, 0.5825 on CIFAR-100, and 0.9588 on SVHN, surpassing brute-force search over 6,000 candidates. The best transform on CIFAR-10 and SVHN comes from a fine-tuned generator using 270 candidates, while the best on CIFAR-100 comes from an off-the-shelf generator using only 10. This needs 22x fewer candidate evaluations in the generation step and 600x fewer for off-the-shelf generations, relative to brute-force search. Beyond transformation discovery, we analyze the reliability of the reduced-budget evaluation commonly used for augmentation search. Correlating one-epoch selection scores with 20-epoch outcomes reveals strong, weak, and absent predictive relationships depending on the dataset and architecture, with correlations ranging from 0.756 to near zero. A positive control indicates that range restriction alone is unlikely to explain the low correlations. Our results indicate that semantic synthesis with code LLMs provides an efficient alternative to search-based transformation discovery and highlight the importance of validating evaluation fidelity when optimizing data transformations.

AI.brief_summary: 在统一训练协议下比较九种数据变换设计策略（标准增强、暴力搜索、两个 LLM 直接生成代码、以及按精度排序数据微调后的性能引导生成），并分析用少 epoch 代理分数预测完整训练结果的可靠性。
AI.relevance_reason: 该文不涉及 latent 状态或视觉推理，但其「低成本代理评估与完整训练结果相关性从 0.756 到近零」的分析，可能为 LVR 中动态计算、提前停止的收益—成本评估与评价保真度提供核查线索。
